newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian stocks (inventories) rise in Q2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian stocks (inventories) rise in Q2.

text.p: The value of stocks held by Australian private businesses rose an estimated 1.3 percent, seasonally-adjusted, in the June quarter from the March quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
The March quarter value of stocks 0.7 percent.
The bureau also said sales by manufacturers fell an estimated 1.4 percent in the June quarter from the March quarter.
Both figures are at constant 1989/90 prices.
Quarterly percentage changes in stocks by industry, seasonally-adjusted. Values in A$ billion -
qtr/qtr June qtr value June qtr 95 value
The bureau said the first estimate for manufacturers' sales in current price terms for 1996/97 ending June 30 is A$182.81 billion.
If realised this would represent a rise of 2.1 percent over 1995/96 sales of A$177.29 billion.
